description: Which guide venues get a live event list, and how to find each one in Ticketmaster's Discovery API. scripts/fetch-events.mjs looks the venue up by name in Atlanta, GA. Set ticketmasterVenueId once it is known to skip the lookup. Events whose name matches any pattern in exclude (case-insensitive regular expressions) are dropped: tours, parking, premium add-ons and other listings that aren't events.
